statement.name: get
statement.sql: select cast(process_definition_id as varchar(36)) as id, process_desc as description, cast(author_id as varchar(36)) as authorID, version, create_datetime as creationDate, process_type_id as typeID, cast(responsible_participant_id as varchar(36)) as ResponsibleID from LU_PROCESS_DEFINITION

statement.name: createActivityInstancesSS
statement.sql:
insert into workflow.dbo.FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE ( activity_instance_id, activity_definition_id, process_instance_id, current_state_id, sub_process_definition_id, priority, activity_desc, activity_implementation_id, loop_condition, start_mode_id, finish_mode_id, automated_class_name, transition_restriction_id, work_item_limit, required_work_item_count, required_ancestor_count, client_status_msg_xml, created_by, create_datetime ) select newid(), activity_definition_id, , 3, sub_process_definition_id, priority, activity_desc, activity_implementation_id, loop_condition, start_mode_id, finish_mode_id, automated_class_name, transition_restriction_id, work_item_limit, required_work_item_count, required_ancestor_count, client_status_msg_xml, , current_timestamp from workflow.dbo.LU_ACTIVITY_DEFINITION
; insert into workflow.dbo.REL_ACTIVITY_PARTICIPANT_RUNTIME ( activity_instance_id, participant_id, participant_type_id, created_by, create_datetime ) select fai.activity_instance_id, rap.participant_id, rap.participant_type_id, , current_timestamp from workflow.dbo.REL_ACTIVITY_PARTICIPANT rap inner join workflow.dbo.FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE fai on rap.activity_definition_id = fai.activity_definition_id

statement.name: createTransitionInstancesSS
statement.sql: insert into workflow.dbo.FACT_TRANSITION_RUNTIME ( transition_runtime_id, transition_desc, process_instance_id, current_state_id, base_transition_id, transition_type_id, from_activity_instance_id, to_activity_instance_id, condition, created_by, create_datetime ) select newid(), transition_desc, , 10, transition_id, transition_type_id, faiFrom.activity_instance_id, faiTo.activity_instance_id, condition, , current_timestamp from workflow.dbo.LU_TRANSITION lt inner join workflow.dbo.FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE faiFrom on lt.from_activity_id = faiFrom.activity_definition_id inner join workflow.dbo.FACT_ACTIVITY_INSTANCE faiTo on lt.TO_ACTIVITY_ID = faiTo.ACTIVITY_DEFINITION_ID
